rules.name: Iron Discipline
rules.description: Orders issued to this unit can be rerolled, and each score of 1 means a free order

rules.name: Agile
rules.description: This unit can always re-roll one d6 when moving or charging

rules.name: Will to Fight
rules.description: If this unit destroyed an enemy unit, it can move up to 10 cm instead of 5 cm

rules.name: Tearing
rules.description: When charging, this unit has WS 4

rules.name: Sun Monolith
rules.description: Roll a d6 for each Wound Desauros lost in combat. A score of 2 or less means that the chosen unit or single model within 20 cm is dealt 2 Wounds

rules.name: Primal Rampage
rules.description: When charging, Desauros must take a d6 test to see if it goes berserk. A score of 2 or less means Desauros gains +3 Attacks

rules.name: Living Catapult
rules.description: Once per cycle, Forgon can spit at an enemy within 20 cm that is not engaged in combat. Roll a d6. A score of 3 or less means the enemy unit must take a Panic Test for its 3 bases

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If the Champion of Sun is attached to a friendly unit engaged in combat, you can make a d6 test. A score of 2 or less means that the enemy unit must re-roll all scores of 1 both in its Weapon Skill Test and Wound Test in this cycle

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When activating any unit within 10 cm of Champion of Nature, you can make a d6 test. A score of 4 or less means that unit may turn freely and may add 3 cm to its move or charge range

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If the Champion of Gods is attached to a friendly unit engaged in combat, you can make a d6 test before the fight. A score of 3 or less means that the unit can re-roll all failed scores during the Weapon Skill Test or the Wound Test

rules.name: Mystic of the Reborn
rules.description: Each friendly unit within 10 cm of the Mystic of the Reborn has a charge range of M + 6 cm + d6 (instead of M + 2d6)

rules.name: Hot Blood
rules.description: The Arox army may re-roll an Initiative Test

rules.name: Armour of the Sun Cities
rules.description: Xan'toag can be eliminated by the enemy from the game only on a score of 1. Moreover, a friendly unit that does not have any armour or protection and has Xan attached to it, may roll for armour save for 3 damage. Each score of 3 or less means a cancelled Wound.

rules.name: Dragon Spear
rules.description: Xan supports a unit with 8 attacks. If an enemy single model gets in base contact with Xan, it is immediately dealt do damage. If the enemy model survived, it can perform a test for eliminating Xan.

rules.name: Trustees of the Club
rules.description:
Replace one base from the chosen unit of Liagulians in your army with the Trustees of the Club. This unit gains Fearless and Will to Fight special rules until the end of battle. If Xan is attached to this unit, it has Strength 4 instead of 3.

Fearless - This unit always passes a Cold Blood Test and a Panic Test
Will to Fight - If this unit destroyed an enemy unit, it can move up to 10 cm instead of 5 cm

rules.name: Ropuchon Hero
rules.description:
Xan attached to a unit of Ropuchons or Golden Guards gives them Frenzy special rule.

Frenzy - When charging, this unit doubles its Attacks (A) stat

sharedRules.name: Gold Armour
sharedRules.description: Each Wound dealt to this unit can be cancelled by an exceptional armour. Roll a d6. A score of 2 or less means a cancelled Wound
